race.title: CopyBet For Nations League Profit Boosts Handicap Hurdle
race.verdict: MR JUKEBOX went close to defying a penalty at Perth when last seen and Warren Greatrex's charge remains unexposed as a handicapper, so gets the verdict over Lydeard Girl who signed off last season with a career-best second at Wincanton. Recent Market Rasen winner Lightning Flash is also considered after a 7 lb rise. MR JUKEBOX (IRE) LYDEARD GIRL LIGHTNING FLASH (IRE)
race.bettingForecast: Lightning Flash (7/4), Mr Jukebox (5/2), Windsor Blue (7/1), Person Of Interest (8/1), Lydeard Girl (8/1), Dublinofficecallin (10/1), City Of Diamonds (16/1)
